rv.q: But at least, in the case of Rachel Wagstaff's stage version of Faulks's celebrated 1993 novel, it is a very good sculpture that captures something of the unimaginable horror, as well as the fractured comradeship, of the first world war.
Sebastian Faulks ’ wonderful 1993 novel Birdsong is a love story, a chronicle of horrendous conditions in the trenches of the First World War, and a tale of amazing human courage and resilience.
